integrity: The proof reuses only explicit displayed inequalities from the primary source and substitutes slowly varying parameters whose admissibility and asymptotic contributions are checked term by term. The large-X tail is reverified from the source's explicit bound, avoiding any invalid appeal to a fixed-parameter theorem with parameter-dependent threshold. The frame-operator estimate follows from Janssen's representation and unitary operator norms. No numerical experiment is used.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to a near-diagonal logarithmic strip and does not give a global product region at the critical n^{-2/3} power. The logarithmic error exponent beta/8 comes from the tracked estimates and is not claimed optimal. No fixed-constant n^{-2/3} safety threshold is proved.
title: Polylogarithmic safety window at the critical Hermite-Gabor exponent
